text:
tariq: Heads-up — I spotted an odd pairing of a provider credit and an APAC egress tax on the March invoice. amount looks off and they both reference the same resource id. :eyes:

maria (finops): Can you paste the raw line items? where in the invoice?

tariq: pasted snippet from the billing CSV:```
InvoiceID,LineItemID,Description,Amount,Currency
INV-2026-03-01,LI-99871,ProviderCredit - Reservation Adjustment,-12345.67,USD
INV-2026-03-01,LI-99872,APAC Egress Tax (10%) ,1234.57,USD
```

lucy-infra: odd — reservation adjustment credit should net to zero after proration, but tax line shouldn't appear on a credit. did we do a late reservation swap or regional move?

sre-jun: billing-bot pulled the linked events: "reservation_replace" for project redwood-infer-prod in asia-southeast1 at 2026-03-01T04:12Z. Ticket FIN-9873 created automatically.

maria (finops): FIN-9873 — good. tagging @lucy-infra for infra change context. lucy, did infra cancel/reserve anything in that window?

lucy-infra: we rotated instance family for a small Dedicated pool (commitment_id=comm-42). The ops script runs a two-step release: cancel old reservation then create new. There was a ~2h gap where cloud reported partial usage then issued a pro-rated credit.

tariq: my hypothesis: provider issued a negative line (credit) for reservation adjustment and their tax engine later applied an outbound egress tax line incorrectly tied to the credit, so both show up but tax should be zero on credits.

sre-jun: confirming from logs: tax_calc service flagged LI-99872 as computed on top of LI-99871 because `base_amount` came back positive in the tax webhook (race in upstream event ordering).

maria (finops): actionables: 1) open provider billing dispute for the tax line (request removal), 2) request invoice reissue to net credit correctly, 3) add guard to our ops script to avoid reservation gaps > 5min. filing internal ticket FIN-9881 for point 3.

lucy-infra: noted. i'll add a preflight check to ensure a standby reservation before swap and backfill KV so no gap. PR coming.

tariq: for the dispute, i drafted a message: "ProviderCredit LI-99871 resulted in a negative adjustment; associated tax LI-99872 appears to be incorrectly applied to a credit. Request removal and invoice reissue." any edits?

maria (finops): fine. attach CSV and reference the reservation_change event id (evt-33421). also ask them to confirm whether this affects commitment usage metrics (we need accurate utilization).

sre-jun: billing-bot: logged FIN-9873 -> linked FIN-9881; assigned to lucy-infra + maria (finops). :white_check_mark:

lucy-infra: quick check — does this affect our committed spend reporting? i.e., will the credit reduce the committed baseline unexpectedly?

maria (finops): short answer: possibly until invoice reissue. we'll treat accounting as provisional and mark the month as "under dispute" in the commit dashboard. i'll also run the Cost Explorer delta to estimate net.

tariq: one more note — if provider support refuses reissue, workaround is to post an internal contra-entry to adjust reported spend and keep reserved capacity metrics intact. prefer trying reissue first.

maria (finops): agreed. i'll open the support case now and paste the ticket link. thanks for catching this, tariq. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Support case #PROV-55621 opened with provider; case owner: akira; expected response SLA 72h.

lucy-infra: PR for reservation swap guard in flight, targeting canary today to avoid future gaps.

tariq: keep updates here; adding FIN-9873 to weekly ops review.

(THREAD END)
